newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX April Brent looks to extend rally after API.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX April Brent looks to extend rally after API.

text.p: April Brent crude futures were indicated firmer in line with NYMEX arbitrage values, supported by a surprise draw in API crude data overnight.
April Brent, which rose 58 cents to $19.50 in London, was quoted on SIMEX at $19.65/$19.75 per barrel.
This was largely in line with the NYMEX/Brent April/April arbitrage of $1.16 based on the last trade for NYMEX April of $20.87.
NYMEX crude has rallied on the after-hours ACCESS system following the release late in New York of API stock data.
They showed an unexpected fall in crude stocks of 7.6 million barrels, or 4.1 million excluding the isolated U.S. west coast. A build of 2.8 million barrels had been expected.
A draw in gasoline stocks of 1.3 million barrels was also price supportive, brokers said. A build of 875,000 barrels had been expected.
April gasoline was up on ACCESS in light trade, last trading at 63.60 cents per gallon, up 0.71 from New York.
April heating oil last traded at 53.70 cents, up 0.36 from New York. API data showed a 603,000 barrel build in stocks, compared with expectations for a 1.375 million draw.
